name: gemma-e2e-android
//resolutions: @genkit-ai/compat-oai pulls openai@4, whose _shims/index.mjs self-imports 'openai/_shims/auto/runtime'. Bun cannot resolve that self-referential specifier through the package's own exports map, so any Genkit import dies at load. openai@5 dropped _shims entirely and loads clean under Bun. Drop this pin once compat-oai depends on openai>=5.
